overview_description.description: Kitchefy is a business-to-business (B2B) company that provides virtual kitchen services to the food and beverage industry. The company works with kitchens as fulfillment partners and aims to inject virtual brands into these fulfillment partners based on a revenue-sharing model that increases both sales and utility rates. Additionally, Kitchefy connects physical restaurants that are already up and running and looking to expand geographically with kitchens that are already up and running in numerous locations without having to worry about location, introductory, or operating costs.
